answer: Make every agent identity carry a non-transferable bonded stake that is slashed on misbehavior. A newcomer cannot slip through a cheap inlet: to vote or attest it must lock real capital, and since each additional identity needs its own fresh bond, running a million fake agents costs a million stakes instead of one. Marginal cost scales linearly while per-sybil reward stays flat, so the attack stops paying. Reputation reinforces this: honest histories form a dense attested nebula impossible to forge, and a pristine ivory newcomer is banded low until staking and earning a record.
